scoring_justification: Checker recomputes Spearman rank correlations and mean TIC ratio directly from the CSV artifact; no trust in agent's reported summary.

outputs.description: Final table containing all computed quantities for every interface in the grid, from which the checker recomputes Spearman rank correlations, the 40K/5K TIC ratio, and IPSA-EMD agreement.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compute (1) Spearman rank correlation between TIC_EMD_40K and bulk_DoS_overlap, (2) Spearman rank correlation between TIC_EMD_40K and IPS_overlap, and (3) for the high_mismatch subset the mean TIC_EMD_40K/mean TIC_EMD_5K ratio. Threshold tolerances are hidden.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden thresholds for rank correlation and TIC ratio
hidden_assets.source_provenance: derived from paper qualitative trends (Figures 2,5a,5b); thresholds set to be achievable by a correct reproduction while excluding random/uninformed guesses
hidden_assets.generation_method: chosen based on expected qualitative relationships: low DoS correlation (<0.5), high IPS correlation (>0.6), TIC ratio >1.2
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These thresholds are not random; they reflect the paper's claims of weak/absent correlation with bulk DoS overlap and strong correlation with IPS overlap, and anharmonic suppression at low temperature.

steps.description: Recompute Spearman rank correlation between TIC_EMD_40K and bulk_DoS_overlap; expect low correlation.
Recompute Spearman rank correlation between TIC_EMD_40K and IPS_overlap; expect high correlation.
Recompute mean TIC_EMD_40K / mean TIC_EMD_5K for high_mismatch subset; expect ratio > 1.2.
